title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 125
paragraphs: As the army was proceeding along this route, lions attacked the camels that carried his provisions. The lions used to come down regularly at night, leaving their haunts, but they touched nothing else — neither baggage animal nor man — only the camels. I wonder what the cause was, what it was that made the lions leave everything else alone and attack the camels only, creatures they had never seen before and had never had any experience of.
